content.text:
application:
  port: 3030
  # Above the 30 s Streamlet client timeout, so a slow route optimization is
  # cut off by its own client rather than by this outer bound.
  request_timeout_secs: 60
database:
  host: "127.0.0.1"
  port: 5432
  username: "postgres"
  password: "postgres"
  database_name: "postgres"
  schema: "public"
  max_connections: 5
  log_statements_level: "debug"
  slow_query_threshold_ms: 500
log:
  level: "info,sqlx=warn,tower_http=debug"
  format: "pretty"
cors:
  allowed_origins:
    - "*"
auth:
  enabled: true
  jwks_refresh_interval_secs: 3600
  jwks_refresh_timeout_secs: 5
mqtt:
  enabled: false
  broker_url: ""
  topic: ""
  client_id: "green-ecolution"
  keep_alive_secs: 30
map:
  # The centre must lie inside bbox; the server refuses to start otherwise.
  center: [54.792277136221905, 9.43580607453268]
  bbox: [54.714822, 9.285796, 54.860127, 9.583800]
  # Zoom range the map is held to; also the instance default for organizations.
  min_zoom: 13
  max_zoom: 18
  nearest_tree_max_radius: 500.0
  nearest_tree_default_limit: 10
